arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, os
fixtures = json.load(open('/workspace/examples/checks.json'))
f = fixtures[0]
data = (f.get('raw') or json.dumps(f['request'],separators=(',',':'))).encode()
t0=time.time()
ps=[subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B','/workspace/submission/main.py'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE) for _ in range(5)]
outs=[p.communicate(data)[0] for p in ps]
print('concurrent rc', [p.returncode for p in ps], 'time', round(time.time()-t0,2))
print('all same', len(set(outs))==1, 'bytes', len(outs[0]))
print('json ok', json.loads(outs[0].decode()) == f['response'])
print('tmp entries', os.listdir('/workspace/tmp'))
EOF
